fusions.name: Gutting Barb
fusions.desc: Drives an iron barb into a wounded enemy, dealing 20 damage, consuming every affliction on it to add 1.3 times their remaining damage, and making it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Barbed Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps a barbed iron hook through a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to each enemy caught, with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Reeled to Heel
fusions.desc: Hooks up to 4 enemies within 7 tiles and drags them onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagged and Held
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your armour rises by 12%.
